label: A favouring determination that misses a verdict of value is not pure
paraphrase: OPEN analyst bridge, attribution deferred: for every favouring profile phi, if phi misses a verdict of the betterness standard (for some scenario and candidates x, y, x is better than y there and phi does not favour x over y there), then the real determination that a favouring of the bearer is phi is not a pure perfection (DEF-PURE-PERFECTION; the same purity parameter as the #2153 premises). With the standard read as value (DEF 071b24f0) it is the loss half of 'restriction of favouring content is limitation'. The Lean type takes the standard as a parameter: the same function with the end-realization ordering as standard is the D-relative form, under which the good-tracking profile, not the D-directed one, is the restricted one. It says nothing about a contingent selection that is not part of a profile.
